mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_item_log (item_id, log_type, from_space_id, to_space_id, operator_user_id, remark, extra) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{logType}, #{fromSpaceId}, #{toSpaceId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{remark}, #{extra})
